ratings.label: coercive
ratings.reason: Demands strict compliance, rejects the analyst's opinions, and threatens replacement and personal blame.

ratings.label: coaching
ratings.reason: Frames the task as development, prompts self-reflection on strengths and blind spots, and tolerates failure for learning.

ratings.label: affiliative
ratings.reason: Centers on warmth, praise, reassurance and removing pressure to build emotional bonds.

ratings.label: pacesetting
ratings.reason: Manager models high standards, demands speed, refuses guidance, and threatens to take over subpar work.

ratings.label: authoritative
ratings.reason: Articulates a clear vision and why it matters, then leaves the means to the analyst's discretion.

ratings.label: none
ratings.reason: Purely administrative description of the brief's structure with no leadership tone.

ratings.label: democratic
ratings.reason: Solicits the analyst's ideas and treats their proposals as a vote shaping team direction.
